notes:
Overview: Mid-market product analytics SaaS (B2B) building conversational product assistant + doc search for customers. Current stack: hosted API PoC -> considering Dedicated for predictable latency and data isolation. Wants clear ramp + commitment plan for next 12 months.

Initial run + POC summary:
- Jan demo: hosted API used to prototype chat flows and embeddings; product team impressed with latency and token-cost charts.
- Feb POC (2-week): integrated embeddings for semantic search, reranking for top-K results; 95th pct latency target met on hosted varients for short contexts (~120ms).
- Tech feedback from engineering: KV cache and prefix caching help, but need dedicated KV sizing for larger tenant cases. SE recommends Dedicated for stable throughput and predictable tail latency.

Pricing / Packaging Negotiation (current):
- Locust Hill preference: commit-based Dedicated with monthly commit and a 20% burst pool for seasonal spikes. Wants clear overage rates and cap to avoid surprise bills.
- Proposed Redwood offer (from AE): 3 commit tiers (100k, 300k, 600k tokens/day equivalent) with burst allowed up to 20% at 1.5x overage rate; 12-month ramp: month1=50% commit, month3=75%, month6=100% commitment. Dedicated SLA and reserved GPU pool.
- Locust Hill counter: ask for graduated overage tiers (first 10% over free at 1.0x, next 20% at 1.25x, beyond at 1.5x) and a one-time credit if usage exceeds commit by >30% during first 2 months. Also requesting a Q3 availability guarantee for extra burst capacity (they run seasonal onboarding spikes).
- Legal: asking for DPA + SOC2 clause, KMS integration details, and 30-day audit log retention by default; data residency specifics for EU customers (some customers in EU, need residency options).

Operational notes:
- SE Rafael ran incident playbook for cache warmup during POC; documented by drive link.
- Engineering concern: model quantization recommendations for cost-savings — Redwood Optimize suggestions needed before final commit.
- Support expectation: 24x5 SE support during ramp, CSM assigned post-commit.
